Hey everyone. It's been a while again! I wanted to refrain from updating on this issue until it either escalated badly, or got resolved. Fortunately, it turned out to be the latter!

First off, I'd like to thank everyone who commented on the last thread and left suggestions on how I should approach this matter. It really helped in putting the situation into perspective and collecting my thoughts.

Anyway, let's get to the story:

After I wrote the previous update post, I made sure to read all of the comments and follow the best suggestions. I've also had some people private message me and tell me of similar experiences that they've had, and how they dealt with them.-- (Which I really appreciated. Seriously. We get a lot of shit on FPH for what we stand for but honestly, the sense of community here is amazing.)-- Most of the suggestions overlapped, and came down to the fact that I should report this to the right people that needed to get involved in this. Which I did; I sent out a bunch of emails to the office of student affairs, the department head, etc.

A day later I receive my first reply from a contact person at the office of student affairs. This woman was very sympathetic, and tried to assure me that this situation would have no negative consequences for me personally. I immediately felt relieved. She also wanted me to come in so she could speak to me personally, which I did. I told her the entire story and I made sure to choose my words wisely so that it was clear that I was the only victim in this scenario. She believed me and said that she would take it from here, and that she would keep me posted on the situation.

A couple of days later I get an email from her that explains how after the lecturer was spoken to by the head of department, she backpedaled and said that she asked me to stay after the class to talk about my report, and to simply suggest for me to be more careful in the future to avoid situations like this one. She apparently said that she had heard a few of the students talk about what happened between me and the ham, and that she was ''simply worried that this could turn out badly'' for me. Fortunately, I told the office of student affairs about how this lecturer knows the fat personally, so that didn't really help her case. She kept denying that she called me in to basically scold me for ''being rude'' to the ham. Apparently she did later apologize to the department head and said that she would do ''anything necessary to correct this misunderstanding''. (Someone's thirsty for that tenure...)

And that was basically the end of that. Somehow the ham walked away without punishment for making this into such a big deal, as she wasn't even spoken to by anyone. The woman at the office of student affairs told me that they only felt the need to address the issue with the lecturer, as she was simply out of line here. The ham also never filed any form of official complaint. I still feel like she should have at least been sternly spoken to about this or something.

So there you have it. That's basically the end to this story. What's funny, though, is that since this happened, I made a few new friends after people started hearing about this and coming up to me to talk about it. I had expected the complete opposite to happen: that people would shun me after she spread her lies. Also, she still shoots me a dirty look whenever I see her, but I enjoy it so much more now that her little plain failed. I just need to make sure I avoid any form of social interaction with her from now on.
